As designated by its title, the text structurally integrates the analytical categories of the *kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states) with the *cittaduka* (the dyad relating to mind or consciousness), examining their conditional relations according to the twenty-four causal conditions (*paccaya*) typical of the *Paṭṭhāna* system.
